text: Authenticate nurses via Azure AD using their existing NHS credentials
Integrate with hospital EPR system using FHIR-based APIs for patient demographics and ward note creation
Synchronize ward notes bidirectionally with SharePoint Online lists via Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps
Allow senior nurses and clinical leads to create, edit (within 15 minutes), and manage ward notes as FHIR Observation resources
Enable Band 5 nurses to view and acknowledge ward notes, recording acknowledgements as FHIR Annotations
Provide a ward selection dropdown populated from EPR Ward Resource list, supporting dynamic mid-shift ward switching with immediate context update
Display a dashboard for senior nurses showing all pending ward notes requiring review and action
Implement draft saving of unsaved notes per nurse, retaining drafts for 48 hours accessible only to the author
Maintain an audit trail of key actions including ward switches, note creations, edits, acknowledgements, and access logs, searchable by authorized audit roles
Enforce note immutability after 15 minutes, with edits creating new versions and annotating replaced originals visible to senior staff
Use a single ASP.NET Core Web API backend serving the Blazor Server frontend and handling EPR and SharePoint integrations
Translate between internal domain model (WardNote entity) and FHIR resources at API boundary, hiding raw FHIR endpoints from clients
Return immediate error to nurse and keep note in draft if EPR write fails, preventing silent data loss
Display a confirmation toast on successful note save with message 'Note saved to EPR' and timestamp, updating UI status accordingly
Perform hourly scheduled sync of notes from EPR to SharePoint via Azure Logic Apps with exponential backoff retry on failures
Flag notes that fail all sync retries for manual review and display them on an admin dashboard within the hour
Restrict read-only access to ward clerks for viewing notes in SharePoint without edit or create permissions
Log all read access by Band 5 nurses and ward clerks in Azure Monitor for audit purposes
Implement auto-scaling of Azure App Service based on CPU usage thresholds during peak shift-change periods
Enforce compliance with UK GDPR, NHS Digital standards, and DSPT controls including encryption, access logging, and audit retention
